content: Plan: REQ-8 atom-grounding + two-phase TV + trust flip (mirrors REQ-5 option-B discipline). T2-S strat_lowering_faithful = T1-S specialized to any oracle grounding to v1 on qfree, PLUS qfree-reflects-v1 conjunct; SFnTvWitness packages (venv, grounding hyp, req-frame wfFrm+Agree+dom!=[]). (B) thermite-lower production quantifier emission. (C) thermite-tv stratified ref encoder + two-phase TV (syntactic=SPIKE-2 normalizer; semantic=Z3 finite-bound fallback; count_where/permutation_of direct-to-semantic; Timeout WITHHOLDS). Will post Decision on the qfree-grounded/rel-model-relative split before finalizing.
